name: Somolekha

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Somolekha writes in Bengali and English and also publishes as Somolekha Sur. Her literary work sits alongside experience in teaching and advertising. Her English poetry collection Yellow Goggles was published by White Falcon Publishing in 2024; Eexpression has also featured her poetry.

“Dilemma”, her poem here, works through fragments rather than a continuous narrative. Water, a stolen childhood, debris and repeated ashes lead into questions of responsibility and an uncertain future. Its isolated words and abrupt pauses leave the reader to feel the gaps between public judgement and damaged lives.
